answer: Hypothesis: Of the 18 original Experimental Economics studies in the meta-regression dataset, exactly 1 was conducted in the United Kingdom (study ee.13, "Deferred compensation in multiperiod labor contracts: an experimental test of Lazear's model", 2011), so the proportion of original studies in Experimental Economics conducted in the United Kingdom is 1 out of 18, approximately 5.6%.
